question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**were**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in** the past tense**, so the correct verb form to use is '**were**'.
 
• '**Be**' is **the present tense form** and cannot be used here.
 
• '**Is**' is also present tense and does not match the tense of the sentence.
 
• '**Was**' is **the singular past tense form **and does not agree with the plural subject **'most appropriate option'.**

 

**​Correct Passage:__** *Twenty five years ago, few people realised that computers **were** about to become part of our daily lives. This short period of time has seen (2)_______ changes, in business, education and public administration. Jobs which took weeks to complete in the past are now carried out in minutes. People who spent all day copying and checking calculations are now freed from these (3)_______. tasks. Students have become as familiar with hardware and software as their parents were with pencils and exercise books.*

*Computerisation of public records has enabled government departments to analyse the needs of citizens in detail. Some of us may wonder, (4) ______, life has really improved as a result of these changes. Many jobs disappeared, for example, when intelligent machines took over the work. Employers complain that clerical (5)________ have become dependent on calculators and cannot do simple arithmetic.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's see why other options are incorrect:
 
 
• Option 1, '**be**', is the present tense form and cannot be used in a past tense sentence.
 
• Option 3, '**is**', is also present tense and does not match the tense of the sentence.
 
• Option 4, '**was**', is the singular past tense form and does not agree with the plural subject 'most appropriate option'.
